name: Humidity Control 4
description:
Boveda's patented 2-way humidity control continually responds to ambient conditions by adding or removing moisture to affect the enclosed environment and deliver the pre-determined relative humidity (RH) level printed on the pack.

It’s well known in science that certain salts mixed with water will naturally regulate humidity. We just patented the way that made it practical for packaging. Other packaging inserts either add moisture or remove moisture. Boveda does both, monitoring the RH (relative humidity) inside the container and regulating to the specific RH engineered into the Boveda.

Available in multiple sizes and humidity levels, Boveda can solve your intermediate moisture need and maintain the ideal moisture content of the items inside your container. Boveda uses all FDA-compliant ingredients and won’t damage anything through direct contact. The life of any Boveda depends how much moisture it releases, which will vary based on climate and container. You’ll know it’s time to replace Boveda when it’s no longer pliable.

It’s impossible for Boveda to over-humidify beyond the RH on the pack. That’s why their usage instructions talk about minimums, not maximums. There’s no such thing as using “too much”. More than the minimum will just last longer.

Use Case
Terpene retention and prevention of moisture loss.

How to Use
Boveda doesn’t need to be activated or maintained. Once the Boveda pack becomes rigid, it’s out of water and needs to be replaced. This could mean weeks to years, depending on the package or container, how much the container is opened/closed and the ambient environment. Yeah, it’s really that simple. For medical instruments, we also know that a number of Boveda formulas are stable under gamma radiation sterilization.

Size
Size 4: Supports up to 1/2 oz. (14 grams) of cannabis

Collaboration isn’t a marketing angle — it’s the foundation of how we work. We build with those who inspire us, and we give back to the communities that built us.

ColdFire has never been about one person. It belongs to the community, to the culture that birthed it, and to the collaborations who helped shape it into something real.

We’re still learning. We’re still growing. And we’re just getting started.  ‍

name: Kompact Gravity Infuser
description:
Introducing the newest sensation from Stündenglass, the Kompact Gravity Infuser. The Kompact features the same patented 360° gravity system, dynamic design, and immersive experience as the original, now available in a more refined, portable size that includes a custom-fit travel case.

Coming in at just under a foot tall, the Kompact is exactly what you need to enjoy the benefits of Stündenglass in an easy to handle package. The smaller globes hold about two thirds of the volume, or 2 cups, compared to the full size, which creates cooler and faster pulls.

The travel case is carefully crafted with high grade fabric and form-fitted to cradle the Kompact Stündenglass, which arrives full assembled. A beautiful metal inlayed logo plate adorns the front with an easy to use zipper, carrying handle and strap for over the shoulder use. Inside, there is space for accessories including a handy pocket to store anything extra you want to bring along with you.

Designed for functional versatility, the Kompact Gravity Infuser is a complete set that includes an aluminum bowl kit and a glass liner but can also connect to any smoking or vaporization device with a 14mm male joint. Also included is a 3-foot silicone hose that can be connected to the 45° adjustable mouthpiece for direct draws or a steady stream of smoke for contactless consumption.

The Kompact is a sophisticated and elegantly designed 360° rotating glass device that generates kinetic motion activation via cascading water displacement, opposing airflow technology, and the natural force of gravity. It is constructed using the highest quality materials, including borosilicate glass globes and aircraft-grade anodized aluminum.

variations.name: Grateful Dead
variations.description: Stündenglass is proud to introduce the Grateful Dead x Stündenglass Kompact, the first in a series of custom device collaborations with world-renowned American rock band and timeless cultural icon, Grateful Dead. Designed for functional portability and packaged in a fully customized, premium travel case, the Grateful Dead x Stündenglass Kompact features the band’s signature imagery and colorways throughout, highlighted by a bold Stealie on the core of the device and white lightning bolts adorning the base.

name: Live Rosin
description:
SunSmoke – Live Rosin

Pure sunshine, no solvents. SunSmoke Live Rosin is 100% sun-grown and solventless, made from cannabis grown on California’s coast. The buds are flash-frozen right at harvest, then washed in ice water to separate the trichomes. Every jar is single-origin and single-harvest, so you get the truest expression of the flower, with big terps and bold flavor at a price that won’t burn you.

variations.name: Kush Mints
variations.description:
Kush Mints

Cool, crisp, and loaded with character. Kush Mints crosses Animal Mints with Bubba Kush. It brings fresh mint and a cookie-like sweetness, plus hints of gas and pine. In sun-grown live rosin form, it melts down smooth and hits with a cool, clean finish. It’s bold, fresh, and a true crowd favorite in every dab.

variations.name: Mint Pied Eyed
variations.description:
Mint Pied Eyed 

Cool, creamy, and a little funky. Mint Pied Eyed layers cool, minty sweetness over a creamy, earthy base with a subtle hit of gassy funk. In sun-grown live rosin form, it’s smooth, rich, and refreshingly different in every dab.

name: Live Rosin
description:
Tempo – Live Rosin Badder

Find your groove. Tempo's live rosin badder is powered by Punch Extracts and made with nothing but ultra-purified ice and water. It's crafted in a climate-controlled space to lock in the plant's natural taste and aroma. The result is a solventless, full-spectrum, full-flavor badder that's smooth, creamy, and easy to dab. Whether you're canna-curious or a seasoned connoisseur, Tempo helps you find your rhythm.

variations.name: Octane Grape(Relax)
variations.description:
Octane Grape – Relax

High-octane flavor, low-key vibes. Octane Grape brings juicy, sweet grape with a bold, gassy kick. It's made to help you relax, unwind, and sink into a laid-back groove. Rich, smooth, and fully fueled in every dab.

variations.name: Alpine Aura(Balance)
variations.description:
Alpine Aura – Balance

Fresh mountain air in every dab. Alpine Aura brings crisp pine and a cool, earthy freshness, like a deep breath on a mountain trail. It's made for a balanced groove, so you stay clear, calm, and right in the middle. Smooth, refreshing, and easy to enjoy.

variations.name: Cosmic Grove(Balance)
variations.description:
Cosmic Grove – Balance

Out of this world, but still grounded. Cosmic Grove brings a fresh, earthy, garden-grown vibe with a touch of something stellar. It's made for a balanced groove, smooth and steady, so you can float without drifting too far. It's creamy, flavorful, and easy to enjoy in every dab.

variations.name: Mint Condition
variations.description:
Mint Condition – Elevate

Fresh, cool, and in perfect shape. Mint Condition hits with crisp, cool mint and a clean, sweet finish that wakes up your taste buds. It's made to elevate your mood and keep your day feeling fresh and bright. Smooth, refreshing, and pristine in every dab.

variations.name: Botanical Bubble Bath(Balance)
variations.description:
Botanical Bubble Bath – Balance

Find your center. Botanical Bubble Bath is a fresh, floral hybrid with a clean, soapy-sweet vibe, like a relaxing bath with a garden view. It's made for a balanced groove, so you're not too up and not too down, just right. It's smooth, aromatic, and creamy in every dab.

name: Live Rosin
description:
Luci Canna Co.

Small batch, big flavor. Luci Canna Co. makes its solventless live rosin from fresh-frozen California cannabis. It's washed in ice water, freeze-dried, and pressed one small batch at a time, with no solvents, just pure plant goodness. Every dab is clean, flavorful, and full-spectrum.

variations.name: Candy Fumez #5
variations.description:

Sweet meets gas. Candy Fumez #5 blends bright, candy-sweet citrus and juicy berry with a bold hit of sweet gas and a little spice. It's sugary, loud, and super flavorful in every dab.

Super Boof is fruity, loud, and full of flavor. Juicy orange and bright citrus lead the way, followed by a sweet, cherry-tinged twist and a floral finish. It’s smooth, zesty, and a hit every time.

Sherbinskis x Doja – Lemon Sherb Live Rosin Joints

Two legends, one zesty joint. Sherbinskis teamed up with solventless pros Doja for these live rosin joints, each hand-crafted with top-tier Sherbinskis flower and infused with high-potency Doja live rosin.

Lemon Sherb – Sativa

Lemon Sherb bursts with bright, zesty lemon and a sweet, creamy sherbet finish, like a scoop of lemon sorbet on a sunny day. It’s tangy, smooth, and full of good vibes from the first spark to the last pull. Grab a pack and share the sunshine.

variations.name: Rasspberry Gelato
variations.description:
Sherbinskis x Doja – Raspberry Gelato Live Rosin Joints

Two legends, one dessert-worthy joint. Sherbinskis teamed up with solventless pros Doja for these live rosin joints, each hand-crafted with top-tier Sherbinskis flower and infused with high-potency Doja live rosin.

Raspberry Gelato – Indica

Raspberry Gelato blends sweet, juicy raspberry with the rich, creamy smoothness of gelato, like a scoop of berry dessert in every pull. It’s fruity, creamy, and seriously indulgent from the first spark to the last hit. Grab a pack and treat yourself.

variations.name: Cherry Gello
variations.description:
Sherbinskis x Doja – Cherry Gello Live Rosin Joints

Two legends, one sweet joint. Sherbinskis teamed up with solventless pros Doja for these live rosin joints, each hand-crafted with top-tier Sherbinskis flower and infused with high-potency Doja live rosin.

Cherry Gello – Hybrid

Cherry Gello bursts with sweet cherry candy and a pop of lemon zest over a creamy, dessert-like base, with a light gassy finish. It’s sweet, smooth, and seriously delicious from the first spark to the last pull. Grab a pack and treat yourself.

name: Live Rosin T1
description:
Punch Extracts – Tier 1 Live Rosin

Top of the line. Tier 1 is Punch’s top-shelf live rosin, made from fresh-frozen cannabis with nothing but ultra-purified ice and water. It’s pressed in a climate-controlled space to lock in every bit of the plant’s natural flavor and aroma. The result is clean, full-spectrum, and loaded with terps, made for connoisseurs who want the best of the best in every dab.

variations.name: GMOZK
variations.description:
GMOZK

Garlic funk meets candy. GMOZK (GMO Zkittlez) leads with GMO’s bold, savory garlic, fuel, and chem funk, then finishes with a sweet hit of Zkittlez fruity candy. It’s loud, gassy, and surprisingly sweet in every dab.

variations.name: New York Sour Boof
variations.description:
New York Sour Boof

Big City funk with a fruity twist. New York Sour Boof brings sour citrus and juicy cherry up front, then hits with a loud, gassy diesel punch and a skunky finish. It’s bold, zesty, and straight-up NYC attitude in every dab.

variations.name: Luma's GMO
variations.description:
Luma’s GMO

Not for the faint of heart. Luma’s GMO, short for Garlic, Mushroom, Onion, is famous for its deep, pungent garlic funk mixed with earthy, savory notes, a diesel kick, and a touch of sweetness. It’s bold, gassy, and unforgettable in every dab.

name: Live Rosin T2
description:
Punch Extracts – Tier 2 Live Rosin

Solventless and seriously flavorful. Punch Extracts’ Tier 2 Live Rosin is made with nothing but ultra-purified ice and water. It’s crafted in a climate-controlled space to lock in every bit of the plant’s natural taste and aroma. Punch makes its rosin in four quality tiers, and Tier 2 gives you top-notch solventless flavor at a great value. It’s clean, terpy, and full of character in every dab.

variations.name: Poochie Juice
variations.description:
Poochie Juice

Tropical up front, funky on the back end. Poochie Juice starts with a crisp, juicy papaya burst, picks up a little spice and fruit in the middle, then finishes with a savory garlic kick. It’s fruity, funky, and seriously flavorful in every dab.

variations.name: Zoda Fumez
variations.description:
Zoda Fumez

Candy soda with a gassy kick. Zoda Fumez fizzes with sweet berry and grape candy, adds a bright citrus pop, and finishes with a bold hit of fuel. It’s sugary, loud, and fully carbonated with flavor in every dab.

variations.name: Honey Bananas
variations.description:
Honey Bananas 

Sweet, sticky, and golden. Honey Bananas lives up to its name, with an unmistakable ripe banana flavor drizzled in rich, golden honey. Punch’s Tier 2 live rosin makes it smooth, sticky-sweet, and full of flavor in every dab.

name: Live Rosin T3
description:
Punch Extracts – Tier 3 Live Rosin

Solventless flavor without the splurge. Punch Extracts’ Tier 3 Live Rosin is made from fresh-frozen cannabis using nothing but ultra-purified ice and water. It’s crafted in a climate-controlled space to keep the plant’s natural taste and aroma intact. Every jar is clean, full-spectrum, and terpy, a solid everyday pick for rosin lovers who want quality and value in one dab.

variations.name: Peanut Butter Breath
variations.description:
Peanut Butter Breath

Nutty, rich, and one of a kind. Peanut Butter Breath is famous for its nutty, earthy flavor, with smooth notes of butter and roasted chestnut. It’s savory, mellow, and unforgettable in every dab.

variations.name: Piña Z
variations.description:
Pina Z

Tropical candy in every dab. Pina Z blends juicy, sun-ripe pineapple with that famous sweet, fruity Z candy flavor. It’s bright, sugary, and island-ready from the first dab to the last.

variations.name: Watermelon Runtz
variations.description:
Watermelon Runtz

Sweet slice of summer with a gassy kick. Watermelon Runtz hits with sugary watermelon candy and a zesty citrus twist, then finishes with an earthy, gassy exhale. It’s juicy, candy-sweet, and loud in every dab.

name: Live Rosin T4

Punch Extracts – Tier 4 Live Rosin

Real rosin, real value. Punch Extracts’ Tier 4 Live Rosin is 100% solventless, made from fresh-frozen cannabis with nothing but ultra-purified ice and water. It’s crafted in a climate-controlled space to lock in the plant’s natural taste and aroma. You get the same clean, full-spectrum Punch process at an easy-going price, so it’s perfect for everyday dabbing.

Rich, nutty, and baked to perfection. Butter Cake brings warm, buttery sweetness layered with roasted nutty notes and a smooth, earthy finish, like a slice of fresh-baked butter cake. It’s creamy, cozy, and pure dessert in every dab.

name: Modül
description:
A state-of-the-art innovation, the Stündenglass Modül ushers gravity infusion technology into the digital age by introducing a direct heating source to any Stündenglass. Boasting an intuitive and versatile design, the Modül forms a seamless, magnetic connection to both full-size and Kompact units, enabling robust heating options for dry material or concentrates through interchangeable tanks that can reach temperature in as little as 15 seconds.

The Stündenglass Modül represents the next revolution in gravity infusion with a collection of features, including a 2.4” high-resolution full-color display and fully customizable session time options, all controlled by an intuitive single-hand dial. A Quartz tank for dry material provides superior output and flavor profiles and can be easily swapped thanks to intelligent magnetic detection technology.

*Stündenglass or Kompact Infuser sold separately

A 90° USB-C charging cable allows for simultaneous charging and use thanks to easy access to the Modül charging port.

Blueberry is a sweet, juicy classic. Premium flower is coated in concentrate and rolled in kief for a moonrock that’s out of this world. Ripe blueberry leads the way, followed by a sugary, berry-jam finish. It’s smooth, fruity, and easy to love.

variations.name: Strawberry

Strawberry

Strawberry is a sweet, juicy classic. Premium flower is coated in concentrate and rolled in kief for a moonrock that’s out of this world. Fresh-picked strawberry leads the way, followed by a sugary, candy-like finish. It’s bright, fruity, and impossible to resist.

variations.name: Hawaiian Mango

Hawaiian Mango

Hawaiian Mango is a trip to the islands. Juicy, ripe mango leads the way, followed by a bright, tropical sweetness and a smooth, sunny finish. It’s fruity, laid-back, and full of aloha.

name: Moonrocks

3, 2, 1… liftoff. Moon Rocket starts with premium flower, infuses it with live resin and organic terpenes, then coats it in golden kief for a potent, flavorful blast in every hit. Strap in and enjoy the ride.

name: Nanomolecular Beverage 100mg 2oz
description:

The Effect Is Smooth And Blissful: A Happy, Uplifted Start That Drifts Into Deep, Calming Body Relaxation. A Dessert-Style Pick For Unwinding In Style.

variations.name: Gelato Fuel

Sweet Cream Meets High-Octane Gas — Gelato Fuel Hits With Pungent Diesel Fuel Layered Over Creamy Berry Sweetness, Brightened By Zesty Citrus And Finishing On A Warm, Doughy Note. The Effect Is Focused And Uplifting Up Top, Balanced By Smooth Relaxation That Keeps You Calm Without Slowing You Down. A Perfectly Balanced Hybrid For Productive Afternoons And Easygoing Evenings.

variations.name: Tropical Slushie
variations.description:
Tropical Slushie

Tropical Slushie is an icy island escape. Juicy pineapple, mango, and passion fruit blend into a cool, sweet, slushy finish. It’s fruity, frosty, and refreshing.

variations.name: Grape Socks
variations.description:
Grape Socks

Grape Socks is sweet with a funky twist. Juicy grape leads the way, followed by a pungent, earthy funk and a smooth, gassy finish. It’s fruity, loud, and anything but ordinary.

variations.name: Dirty Lemon
variations.description:
Dirty Lemon

Dirty Lemon is zesty with a gritty edge. Sour, tangy lemon leads the way, followed by a pungent, earthy funk and a sharp, gassy finish. It’s bright, bold, and a little rough around the edges.

variations.name: Dragon Cookies
variations.description:
Dragon Cookies

Dragon Cookies are sweet with a fiery kick. Sweet, doughy cookie notes lead the way, followed by a hint of tropical fruit and a warm, spicy, earthy finish. It’s rich, smooth, and full of fire.

variations.name: Secret Gelato
variations.description:
Secret Gelato

Secret Gelato is a sweet treat worth keeping to yourself. Creamy gelato and sweet berry lead the way, followed by a hint of citrus and a light, gassy finish. It’s smooth, rich, and a little mysterious.

name: Premium Flower 3.5g
description:
Welcome to Wizard Trees, where cannabis cultivation meets artistry. Based in Los Angeles, we're known for our artisanal approach to crafting premium cannabis strains sought after worldwide. In smaller batches, we meticulously nurture our plants to ensure unparalleled quality.

Green Jars & Purple Jars

variations.name: Black Magic
variations.description:
Black Magic – Indica

Black Magic is a clone-only connoisseur pick from Wizard Trees, and it’s candy and gas redefined. Sweet, candy-like notes lead the way, followed by a loud, gassy finish. It’s dripping with resin and bursting with color, a potent indica with a flavor all its own.

variations.name: Tide Banger
variations.description:
Tide Banger – Hybrid

Tide Banger is a wave of loud flavor. Gassy diesel and sweet blueberry from Tide lead the way, followed by a creamy, fruity sherbet note from the Banger side. This hybrid is bold, smooth, and hits hard.

variations.name: Black Light
variations.description:
Black Light – Sativa
Genetics: Limelight x Black Magic

Black Light brings two of Wizard Trees’ top in-house strains together. Pungent, gassy notes lead the way, followed by a heavy, zesty lime finish. This sativa kicks off with energetic, euphoric focus, then settles into a smooth, relaxed glow.

variations.name: Smoothie
variations.description:
Smoothie – Hybrid

Smoothie is one of Wizard Trees’ day-ones, rebuilt into something special. Juicy strawberry terps layered with sweet, candy-like notes make one of the best strawberry smoothie profiles out there. This hybrid packs one of the strongest punches on their roster, with an old-school, sit-down kind of hit, and the flavor stays pure from start to finish.

variations.name: Tea Party
variations.description:
Tea Party – Sativa
Genetics: Tea Time x Zangria

Tea Party is candy-on-candy mayhem, one of Wizard Trees’ loudest candy strains yet. Zangria adds depth, color, and resin to their award-winning Tea Time cut. It’s sweet and sticky, with vibrant flavor and all gas, no gimmicks. This sativa is mellow but sneaky, so puff with caution.

name: Premium Flower 3.5g
description:
Hand Crafted


All aspects of our cultivation are manually controlled and truly crafted by hand. We make a point of giving each plant individualized attention to ensure that all plants are equally cared for. With our expansive genetic library, we cultivate 10-15 strains at once, which requires us to be very attentive throughout the plants entire life. Each strain is cared for differently depending on the genetics' unique characteristics of growth. Applying meticulous hands-on techniques and specially formulated recipes with the sole purpose of creating the finest and most flavorful cannabis in the world, we are able to produce products that are rightfully in their own elite level of what cannabis can and should be.

Hand Trimmed


It is extremely important to us that the flowers are never mishandled to ensure the cannabinoids and terpenes are preserved to the highest degree possible. All leaves and stems are carefully removed keeping in tact all the calyxes and pistils while never directly touching the actual flowers.

Hand Packaged


To ensure elite quality down to each and every gram, we carefully hand package all of our flowers. We believe that delicately hand-packaging flowers is the best way to truly preserve the integrity of the product.

-----------------------------------------------------------

Creamy citrus with a funky twist. Orange Julius tastes just like its namesake, with smooth, creamy orange and bright citrus, plus surprising pungent blue cheese undertones that keep things interesting. It’s zesty, creamy, and uplifting in every hit.

Order up! Hashburger serves a savory, old-school hash flavor with deep earthy funk, a peppery spice, and a hint of fuel, all brightened with a touch of lemon and pine. It’s rich, dank, and totally satisfying in every hit.

name: Premium Smalls
description:
Hand Crafted


All aspects of our cultivation are manually controlled and truly crafted by hand. We make a point of giving each plant individualized attention to ensure that all plants are equally cared for. With our expansive genetic library, we cultivate 10-15 strains at once, which requires us to be very attentive throughout the plants entire life. Each strain is cared for differently depending on the genetics' unique characteristics of growth. Applying meticulous hands-on techniques and specially formulated recipes with the sole purpose of creating the finest and most flavorful cannabis in the world, we are able to produce products that are rightfully in their own elite level of what cannabis can and should be.

Hand Trimmed


It is extremely important to us that the flowers are never mishandled to ensure the cannabinoids and terpenes are preserved to the highest degree possible. All leaves and stems are carefully removed keeping in tact all the calyxes and pistils while never directly touching the actual flowers.

Hand Packaged


To ensure elite quality down to each and every gram, we carefully hand package all of our flowers. We believe that delicately hand-packaging flowers is the best way to truly preserve the integrity of the product.

-----------------------------------------------------------

name: Value Flower
description:
Quality smoke. Everyday price...💨

 Get more green for your buck with our In-House Value Flower — reliable, flavorful, and perfect for everyday sessions. Quality buds at a price that makes sense.

variations.name: Watermelon Hubba Bubba
variations.description: Watermelon Hubba Bubba is a heavy indica-leaning hybrid from a Fudo × Bubba Kush cross. It delivers a deeply sedating, relaxing high — heavy body ease with hungry, sleepy effects that can tip into couch-lock at higher doses, best for evenings. It smells and tastes bold and sweet with fruity watermelon and grape-candy notes over a skunky, musky base.

variations.name: Grande Guayaba
variations.description:
Genetics: Gelato x Guava
Grande Guayaba s a mostly-indica hybrid from a Gelato × Guava cross. It delivers a balanced high — a euphoric, uplifting head lift paired with creamy, relaxing body effects. It smells and tastes of sweet tropical guava with creamy and gassy undertones.

variations.name: Green-Cush
variations.description:
Genetics: Skunk #1 × Afghani landrace 
Green-Cush is a Skunk #1 × Afghani landrace cross. Despite its mostly-indica structure, it delivers a strong, buzzy, sativa-like cerebral high — alert, energetic, and uplifting, kicking in fast and ideal for daytime use. It smells and tastes intensely sweet and fruity with mango and pineapple notes over a smooth, creamy earthiness.

variations.name: BIO-Diesel
variations.description:
Genetics: Sour Diesel x Sensi star
Bio-Diesel is a balanced hybrid (~50/50) bred from Sour Diesel, Sensi Star. It delivers a fast, powerful cerebral rush of euphoria and energy that's uplifting, creative, and focused, backed by a warm, aches-easing body relaxation from its Sensi Star side. It smells and tastes of gassy, sour diesel and skunk with sharp citrus, pine, and sweet undertones.

variations.name: Grape Workhardt
variations.description: Grape Workhardt is an indica-dominant hybrid whose exact lineage is closely guarded by breeders. It delivers a swift, calming high — a wave of relaxation that melts away stress and deepens into a heavy, sedating body ease, making it a go-to for evening use and sleep. It smells and tastes of sweet grape candy and syrup with sour cherry, berry, citrus, and earthy pine-fuel undertones.

variations.name: Lemon Z
variations.description:
Genetics: Las Vegas Lemon Skunk x Zkittlez

Pure Citrus Sunshine — Lemon Z Snaps With Sharp Lemon Peel And Sour Candy Sweetness, Softening Into A Creamy, Slightly Skunky Finish That Keeps You Coming Back. The Lift Is Bright And Clear-Headed: Energized, Focused, Creative, And Quick To Turn Giggly. A Zesty Daytime Favorite For Getting Things Done And Having Fun While You Do It.

variations.name: The Goat Milk
variations.description:
Genetics: Cereal Milk × Georgia Pie
The Goat Milk is a hybrid from a Cereal Milk × Georgia Pie cross. It delivers a fast-hitting, sativa-driven high — energetic, uplifting, and euphoric with mental stimulation and motivation, backed by a mild, relaxing body ease. It smells and tastes sweet and nutty with dominant berry notes and hints of vanilla and menthol.

variations.name: NOHO Cherrys
variations.description: Sweet Cherry Bliss With A Creamy Twist — NoHo Cherries Pops With Ripe Dark Cherry And Candied Berry, Rolling Into Smooth Dessert Cream And A Touch Of Citrus Zest On The Finish. The Vibe Lands Warm And Easy: Happy, Mellow, And Comfortably Relaxed Without Losing The Sparkle. A Sweet-Tooth Favorite For Golden-Hour Sessions And Good Moods.

variations.name: Milk & Cookies
variations.description:
Genetics: Cookies N Cream x Triple OG

Dessert Hour, Bottled — Milk And Cookies Serves Up Sweet Vanilla, Warm Cookie Dough, And Buttery Cream, Finished With A Cozy Earthy Spice That Keeps It Grounded. The Feeling Is Pure Comfort: Relaxed, Giggly, And Wonderfully Content, With An Appetite That Shows Up Right On Cue. An Indica-Leaning Treat Built For Easy Evenings, Good Laughs, And Total Wind-Down Mode.

variations.name: Gas Face
variations.description:
Genetics: Face Mints x Biscotti Sherbet

Loud, Bold, And Living Up To Its Name — Gas Face Hits With Rich Diesel Fuel And Sour Citrus, Layered With Spicy Herbs, Cool Mint, And A Sweet Cookie Undertone That Rounds It All Out. The Experience Starts Bright And Creative Up Top, Then Sinks Into A Deep, Blissful Full-Body Stone. An Indica-Leaning Heavyweight For Experienced Fans, Late Nights, And Serious Relaxation.

variations.name: Cereal Milk
variations.description:
Genetics: Snowman x Y-Life

Nostalgia In Every Pull — Cereal Milk Tastes Exactly Like The Sweet Stuff Left At The Bottom Of The Bowl: Sugary Cream And Soft Vanilla With Bright Berry Fruit And A Peppery Spice Kicker. Perfectly Balanced In Effect, It Brings A Cheerful, Clear-Headed Lift Alongside Smooth Body Ease That Never Tips Too Far Either Way. A Feel-Good All-Rounder For Lazy Mornings, Bright Afternoons, And Anything In Between.

variations.name: Sour Skunk
variations.description:
Genetics: Chemdawg 91 x Super Skunk

A Legend That Still Hits — Sour Skunk Comes Roaring In With Bold Fuel And Sharp Citrus Sourness, Backed By Spicy Herbal Notes And That Unmistakable Skunky Punch. The Onset Is Fast And Electric: Energizing, Mood-Lifting, And Laser-Focused, With Staying Power That Carries You Through The Whole Afternoon. A Timeless Daytime Classic For Creative Work, Big Plans, And Getting Motivated.

variations.name: Skittles x GP
variations.description:
Genetics: Zkittlez x Gary Payton

A Candy Shop With Attitude — Skittlez x GP Bursts With Sweet Tropical Fruit And Grape Chew, Then Turns Creamy And Rich With A Cool Gassy Edge On The Exhale. The Feel Is Smooth And Balanced: A Bright, Chatty Lift Up Top Melting Into Deep Full-Body Calm. A Flavor-Lover's Delight For Easy Afternoons, Great Conversation, And Settling In Just Right.

variations.name: Sherbacio

Genetics: Sunset Sherbet x Gelato 41

Creamy, Fruity, And Effortlessly Smooth — Sherbacio Layers Sweet Berry Sherbet And Bright Citrus Over Rich Gelato Cream, Finishing With A Nutty Warmth And Just A Kiss Of Gas. The Balance Is The Magic Here: A Quick Euphoric Rush That Turns Chatty And Uplifted Before Easing Into Relaxed, Happy Calm. A True Crowd-Pleaser For Any Time Of Day And Any Kind Of Company.

name: Value Smalls

variations.name: Triple Zoap

Sweet, Floral, And Delightfully Weird — Triple Zoap Leads With Tropical Guava And Candied Citrus, Then Lands That Signature Clean, Almost Soapy Finish That Makes This One So Easy To Spot. The Vibe Is Balanced And Bubbly: Giggly, Euphoric, Social, And Relaxed Without Pulling You Under. A Great Pick For Good Company, Good Food, And A Day That Deserves A Little Sparkle.

variations.name: Frozen Cherry

Chilled Cherry Candy With A Twist Of Citrus — Frozen Cherry Opens On Bright Red Fruit And Sweet Orange, Then Melts Into A Cool, Creamy Diesel Finish That Lingers Beautifully. Indica-Leaning And Deeply Comfortable, It Settles The Body Into Full Relaxation While Keeping The Mood Warm And Happy. Perfect For Slow Evenings, Cozy Couches, And Letting The Day Melt Away.

name: Vape Battery
description:
The Maven Battery 510 is a sleek and compact device designed for use with cannabis oil cartridges. It features a universal 510 thread that fits most standard vape cartridges, making it incredibly versatile. The battery has three different voltage settings to choose from, allowing users to customize their vaping experience based on personal preference or the type of cartridge being used.
With its durable aluminum construction and long-lasting battery life, this device offers reliable performance in any situation. Its simple one-button operation makes it easy to use even for beginners while still providing advanced functionality for experienced vapers.
Overall, if you're looking for an affordable yet high-quality vaporizer battery that can handle all your needs when using cannabis oils - look no further than the Maven Battery 510!

WHOA gummies pack bold, juicy flavor into every bite, from fruity classics like strawberry lemonade, green apple, and mixed berry to spicy-sweet twists like mango chile and watermelon con chile. Each pack is portioned for easy, consistent dosing, so you can enjoy at your own pace. Start low, go slow, and enjoy the ride.

variations.name: Governmint Oasis
variations.description:
overnmint Oasis

Governmint Oasis is a cool escape to paradise. Fresh, cool mint leads the way, followed by bright tropical fruit and a sweet, refreshing finish with a light touch of gas. It’s smooth, crisp, and classified as a vibe.

variations.name: Black Magic
variations.description:
Black Magic

Black Magic casts a dark, delicious spell. Rich, earthy kush and sweet dark berry lead the way, followed by a pungent, gassy finish. It’s bold, smooth, and seriously enchanting.

variations.name: Sour Diesel
variations.description:
Sour Diesel

Sour Diesel is a legend with a punch. Sharp, pungent diesel fuel hits first, followed by zesty, sour citrus and a tangy finish. It’s loud, bright, and full of energy, a classic that never quits.

variations.name: GMO
variations.description:
GMO

GMO is funky, savory, and gassy. Garlic and earthy, mushroom-like notes come first, then a sharp diesel funk. It’s loud, bold, and a must for anyone who loves the stinky stuff.
